query:
SELECT LEFT(body, 300) AS "body!"
        FROM logs
        WHERE ts >= now() - make_interval(secs => $1)
          AND ($2 = '' OR service_name = $2)
          AND severity >= $3
          AND ($4 = '' OR body ~* $4)
          AND ($5 = '' OR attributes->>$5 = $6)
        ORDER BY ts DESC
        LIMIT 5
